answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7594 Country: India Title: Aas Salaamu alaikum warahmatullahi wabarkatuhu, I would like to know the meaning of the following names : Munirul Haque Mokhtarul Haque and Noor-E-Ashma Jazakallahu Khairan. Question: Aas Salaamu alaikum warahmatullahi wabarkatuhu, I would like to know the meaning of the following names : Munirul Haque Mokhtarul Haque and Noor-E-Ashma Jazakallahu Khairan. Answer ID: 7594 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1219/205=TL/1429) The meanings of the names are as follows: (1) Munirul Haque: the illuminator of truth (2) Mokhtarul Haque: the chooser of truth (3) Noor-E-Ashma: Noor means: light, I do not know the meaning of Ashma. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
